questions.answer: The paging tool automatically pages the secondary on-call. If the secondary also doesn't acknowledge within another 15 minutes, the page goes to the team's engineering manager. For a SEV1, you can skip the timers and call the secondary directly through the incident phone bridge on extension 304, which rings the secondary and the manager at the same time. Do not escalate by Slack alone. If the incident touches customer data or robot safety, also page the Security Lead and Robotics Firmware on-call using the paging tool's "additional responders" option.
